Hi Marissa,

We'd like to schedule a demo of Redwood for our infra and security teams. Key stakeholders: myself (US East), Priya Sharma (EU - security lead), and a couple of SRE engineers based in APAC.

- Wed May 13, 18:00 UTC / 14:00 ET / 19:00 BST / Thu May 14 03:00 AEST

Would you be able to propose two 30-40 minute slots next week? Ideally one that lands in the 08:00-16:00 local window for APAC attendees (AEST), and one that is friendly for US/EU.

Thanks — Lucas
